decisions_prises_en_ton_nom: the parallel retired-artifacts manifest from the first implementation was replaced by a delete-tree action in the existing checksum removal script, after the structural lens flagged it as duplication
delete-tree removes a retired skill folder whole when its SKILL.md is unmodified, including files a user added inside it; an edited SKILL.md keeps the folder
retired commands now defer to the checksum layer in the global purge too, so an edited global copy is kept instead of purged
the project purge runs whenever a project manifest exists (install, merge or update), and is skipped when .claude, .claude/skills or .claude/commands is a symlink
project mode never manages the Skillz source checkout or the global ~/.claude (physical paths compared)
the dead-link sweep only removes dead links pointing into the Skillz skills folder; the Codex skill sweep is narrowed accordingly, while the pre-existing Codex prompt sweep is unchanged
manifests no longer carry a timestamp and are written atomically
tests/test-install-cleanup.sh added to the manifest test command
